items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 19 November 2026 10:30pm
items.description:
##Today##

Possibly the odd spot of rain early tonight, but becoming dry and chilly as the cloud clears and the wind eases, bringing a risk of ice developing on any damp surfaces. Minimum temperature for the overnight period: 2°C. Comments: Risk of frost and ice overnight.

##Tomorrow##

A chilly start to the day as temperatures dip close to zero before sunrise, bringing a risk of ice on any damp and untreated surfaces. Then a dry and sunny day ahead with a light breeze and temperatures up to 9°C. Temperatures will quickly fall after sunset, bringing another risk of frost and ice. Comments: Risk of frost and ice.

##Saturday, 21 November 2026##

Another chilly start with a risk of frost and ice in places. Then a dry day with sunny spells and a light easterly wind gradually strengthening, becoming a fresh to strong southeasterly by the evening. Temperatures up to 9°C. Comments: Risk of frost and ice. Strong winds later.

Dry with sunny intervals, becoming cloudier later in the day, with a strong easterly wind gradually easing. Temperatures up to 9°C. Comments: Strong winds. Risk of coastal overtopping around high tide.
